info.name: Blog API (auth + post services)
info.description:
All APIs of the blog project.

**Quick start**
1. Start both services (`npm run dev` in `auth/` and `post/`).
2. Run **1. Auth → Signup**. The token is saved automatically.
3. Try the requests in **2. Posts**.

**Run everything:** right-click the collection → *Run collection*. Folders run in order.

**How the token works:** protected requests use *Bearer Token* `{{token}}` from the collection's Authorization tab (they show "Inherit auth from parent"). Public requests are set to *No Auth*.

**Variables** (collection → Variables tab): `authUrl`, `postUrl`, `password`, and `jwtSecret` (only for the expired-token test). Others are filled in by scripts.

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Signup, login and profile. Auth service, port 4000.

request.description:
Create a new account. Returns the user (without the password) and an access token.

**Rules:** `name` 2-50 chars · `email` valid, unique · `password` 8-72 bytes with a letter and a number.

The pre-request script makes a new random email each time so you can click Send repeatedly. The test script saves `token` and `userId`.

item.name: 2. Posts
item.description: Create, read, update, delete posts. Post service, port 5000. Reading is public; writing needs a token.

request.description:
Create a post as the logged-in user. The author is taken **from the token**: an `author` field in the body is ignored.

**Rules:** `title` 3-150 chars · `content` 1-20000 chars. The test script saves `postId`.

exec: // Makes a token that expired 1 minute ago, signed with your real secret.
// Set the collection variable `jwtSecret` to JWT_SECRET from your .env first,
// otherwise the API answers TOKEN_INVALID instead of TOKEN_EXPIRED.
const payload = encode({ sub: pm.collectionVariables.get('userId'), jti: 'expired-demo', iat: now - 3600, exp: now - 60, iss: 'blog-auth-service', aud: 'blog-api' });

item.name: 4. Logout
item.description: Run last: logging out revokes the token used by the other folders.
